# Knightshopper

 ![Knightshopper](/Images/Knightshopper.png)

Repo: https://puni.sh/api/repository/knightmore

- Knightshopper is a Dalamud plugin for FFXIV that automates vendor purchases from saved shopping lists.
- Browse vendors, prices, and shop menus, then set how much of each currency to keep in reserve. Other plugins can request purchases through IPC with your permission.
